quotes: Xibo uses the concept of Displays which are managed from the CMS to control when and how content is shown as well as provide device management tools for Users. A Display is an essential part of digital signage as is it bridges the communication between the CMS software (Content Management System) and Media Player App.
sources.limitations: Xibo 社区版 CMS 采用 AGPL-3.0 协议，部分高级播放器为商业扩展，按规则标为 needs_review；本页为 Displays 章节手册，其余章节未逐页抓取。
sources.why_selected: 补 S14 信息发布：Xibo 官方手册 Displays 章节（docs.xibosignage.com），清晰定义 CMS 与终端播放器授权、心跳状态、离线缓存播控等边界。

sources.title: microsoft/SmartHotel360-IoT
quotes: The integrated magnetometer, is being utilized to demonstrate the ability to detect the room occupancy. It is mimicking the idea that we could detect the opening and closing of a door with a magnet on it.
The color of RGB LED indicates what the current setting of the room's light is.
sources.limitations: Microsoft 官方开源参考架构（已归档），采用 Azure Digital Twins + MXChip 硬件原型演示酒店客房温控/照明/门磁占用状态，并非传统 RS-485/KNX 商用 RCU 硬件固件。
sources.why_selected: 补 S22 客控系统：MIT 开源酒店客房物联网参考实现（101 星），涵盖房间空间建模、门磁占用检测、灯光与温湿度传感控制闭环。

sources.title: Hotel Room Controller (GitLab)
quotes: Hotel Room Controller là thiết bị Thu thập - Xử lý - Điều khiển các thiết bị trong phòng khách sạn
sources.limitations: GitLab 开源嵌入式客房控制器毕业设计仓库（越南语 README，未声明 LICENSE 故标为 needs_review）；包含 ADC/DAC/I2C RTC/PWM/SPI/UART/digital_input.c 等硬件驱动源码，不含酒店 PMS 对接。
sources.why_selected: 补 S22 客控系统：独立托管平台（gitlab.com）的嵌入式酒店客房控制器源码仓库，体现底层传感采集与开关/PWM 执行器实作。

sources.title: SmartHotel360 Reference Architecture Portal
quotes: SmartHotel360 has implemented a Hotel Management solution built on top of Azure Digital Twins. The goal of the solution is to generate critical insights from the hotel to optimize building and energy efficiency, improve occupant experience and productivity of hotel personnel.

This solution empowers both the Occupant and the Hotel employees (from Head of Operations to Managers) to control and remotely change settings of rooms, as well as ensure the hotel is always operating to its maximum efficiency.
sources.limitations: 与 SRC-304 同属 Microsoft SmartHotel360 参考工程家族（不同独立站点 microsoft.github.io）；展示住客端与酒店运维端分角色客控及能耗优化闭环，无现场商用接线规范。
sources.why_selected: 补 S22 客控系统：独立站点（microsoft.github.io），完整阐述住客与酒店多角色对客房设备远程调节、能耗优化与设施运维的业务流程。
